title: Starting Program
author: Atacan Turan
desc: Kickstart your fitness journey with the Starting Program, designed specifically for beginners looking to build strength and muscle. Over the course of one week, you'll engage in a single, focused workout that combines essential exercises like the Incline Bench Press and Lat Pulldown, targeting major muscle groups for balanced development. With a total workout time of 80 minutes, this program emphasizes proper form and technique, ensuring you lay a solid foundation for future gains. Equip yourself with a full gym and get ready to elevate your training!
